### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Missed-recovery review of payday 2026-10-16** (covers every payday since LED). Scope: a shortfall carries pay date 10-16 ≥ LED 08-22 → missed-recovery review; due (settlement on plan, no write-off, day after payday). Landing: never up; never higher than one below Premier Plus = Premier; no write-off → no reset; lowest of the protections:
- payroll-continuity: period closes with pay date in last three months: 08-07, 08-21, 09-04, 09-18, 10-02, 10-16 = 6 (07-24 is 3 whole months back) → "five or more → one below" = Premier;
- repeat-shortfall: shortfalls with pay date in last twelve months: 1 → one below = Premier;
- cure: authorization true + card active → EWA recovery debits posted to card in last month 40.00 / 73.59 = 54.4 % → "50 percent or more → one below" = Premier;
- tenure: hire 2024-09-03 → payday 2026-10-16 = 773 days → one below = Premier;
- write-off history: none → one below = Premier.
Result **Paystride Access Premier**, level_effective_date **2026-10-17**. Fall-back (landing rule alone, no protection found): rule 1 "returns to Paystride Access Starter" → Starter (definite, different).

**(b) Instant transfer amount (tier Premier).** Scope: one plan, no repaying loan, configured 55 ≥ Premier 50 → schedule applies (on un-reviewed Premier Plus, 60 > 55, the schedule would not apply).

- Root: instant transfer (worker's own write).
- Hop A (state-derived): instant_debit_card_transfer_and_request — "The instant transfer amount is not worked out until the plan's level effective date falls after the pay date of its latest period close line, where that pay date is before today and a shortfall carries a pay date on or after the level effective date." Records: LED 08-22 ≤ 10-16, shortfall 10-16 → unmet. Search with "level effective date"/"shortfall carries a pay date on or after" → missed_recovery_review_reference scope + "that day is recorded as the plan's level effective date". Due-rule met.
- No fee hop (fee zero; and the bank-fee policy covers bank transfers only).
- No hop pre-solved.

### Counter-proofs
- Do only the transfer now on Premier Plus: excluded by the prerequisite sentence; also the instant schedule's scope would fail (60 > 55) and leave the base rule.
- Tier review instead: excluded — scope "when no shortfall carries a pay date on or after the plan's level effective date".
- Landing Starter (rule 1 read alone) / two below: excluded by the protection ladders all giving one below.
- Open shortfall via the base 3.3 multiplier (share × percent): retired for instant transfers; method case 1 applies since 33.59 ≤ 73.59.
- Paystride card destination: refused by the customer.
